title: Wall-Closing Treatment on Reconstruction Drywall and Insulation Lines after Company Mitigation
content:
A drywall or insulation line on a Reconstruction change order closes walls over framing the loss reached. Its wall-closing treatment is the treatment rate times the quantity written on the proposal, the wall area the line closes, and is charged on that line.

**Treatment rate.** The treatment rate is chosen from the company mitigation job that preceded the rebuild at the same loss — the job recorded on the contract as its preceding mitigation job:

| Preceding company job | Treatment rate |
|---|---|
| a Water Damage Mitigation job assessed category 3 | that water job tier's antimicrobial rate per square foot |
| a Fire & Smoke Mitigation job | that fire job tier's odor sealer rate per square foot |
| a Mold Remediation job | that mold job tier's encapsulation rate per square foot |

Every other line, and a drywall or insulation line with no such preceding job, carries no wall-closing treatment. A water job assessed category 1 or category 2 is not such a job.

## Points of judgement

| Line | Preceding company job | Wall-closing treatment |
|---|---|---|
| drywall or insulation | water job, category 3 | antimicrobial rate times the quantity written |
| drywall or insulation | water job, category 1 or 2 | none |
| drywall or insulation | fire job | odor sealer rate times the quantity written |
| drywall or insulation | mold job | encapsulation rate times the quantity written |
| drywall or insulation | none recorded | none |
| paint, baseboard, flooring, cabinet, labor or any other line | any | none |

## Example (hypothetical rate)

A drywall line written for 210 square feet on a rebuild that followed a category 3 water job whose tier's antimicrobial rate is assumed at $0.40 per square foot carries a treatment of $84.00.
